mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that drives wage growth and inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong demand environment and a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts increase and unemployment rate decreases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a decrease in supply and a potential increase in prices, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signal a tightening monetary cycle and increasing inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate rises and the consumer price index increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong labor market and a potential increase in consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment increases and the unemployment rate decreases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales and a decrease in housing starts signal a weak demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when retail sales decline and housing starts decrease (t-test p > 0.05).
